static_api_claims.claim: Import spacr and inspect package version; preserve version in analysis notes
spacr-run --list lists batch command keys and Python entry functions; Annotate remains interactive
spacr-run --describe regression names spacr.ml.perform_regression and required inputs/defaults; omit --dry-run to execute
spacr.report.build_report is importable source function with required src and out arguments
--settings loads saved CSV/JSON and --dry-run resolves configuration/preflights without invoking analysis; Regression pairs scores/count tables

required_metadata_repairs: Rebind13 review english_sha256 values to normalized current5182c3ef; preserve all translation prose/review history.
Refresh only scene1 related_lessons in all14published catalogs and generated JS from archived02/03 to currentmerged02/04; preserve audio/video/timings.
limitations: No source, review, catalog or media edits. No API/CLI execution, package/environment command, model, app, browser, audio/video decode or synthesis.

Static source support and exact translation/catalog closure do not establish visual command readability, acoustic onset completeness, human listening or native-speaker acceptance. Existing translation review provenance is preserved, not upgraded.
Catalog narration_voices and physical sidecar inventory are recorded separately; player dropdown behavior is outside this assessment.
Critical literal token omissions are screening metadata, not automatic mistranslation findings. Sentence/acoustic pronunciation inspection is outside scope.
